call.text: The authors selected sinusoidal positional encodings because they hypothesized the function would let the model easily learn to attend by relative positions and might allow extrapolation to longer sequence lengths [AIAYN:3.5:c020]. They also tried learned positional embeddings and observed nearly identical results to the sinusoidal version, with the learned variant yielding a dev perplexity of 4.92 and BLEU of 25.7, matching the base model’s performance [AIAYN:3.5:c020][AIAYN:6.2:c031].
